name: Oily Skin
description: Oily skin is characterized by a higher than normal production of sebum, leading to an appearance of shininess, enlarged pores, and a tendency towards acne.

morning_routine.action: Cleanse with a gentle, oil-free cleanser

night_routine.action: Cleansing with an oil-free cleanser to remove excess sebum and daytime grime
night_routine.purpose: Prepare the skin for nighttime care

weekly_care: Exfoliate with a mild scrub or chemical exfoliant to remove dead skin cells
dont: Skip the SPF even on cloudy days
Use greasy or heavy skincare products
Rub your face vigorously when cleansing

seasonal_care.summer: Increase frequency of exfoliation to manage excess oil
seasonal_care.winter: Be cautious about over-drying skin and use hydrating toners
seasonal_care.monsoon: Focus on controlling sebum production with salicylic acid

expert_tips: Consult a dermatologist for personalized skincare recommendations
